intent: Preserve and improve the proven engineering foundation while product logic is replaced incrementally.
protectedCapabilities: EAS remote build project identity and profiles
changeRules: A protected capability may be improved but must not be removed without a tested replacement.
Deletion requires the replacement to be connected to the live runtime in the same change.
Toolchain version changes require all mobile configuration checks and runtime smoke checks to pass.
EAS project IDs, Android package names, and iOS bundle identifiers must remain stable unless an explicit migration is approved.
Docker volumes and production-like local data must not be destroyed by ordinary verification commands.
Product-logic cleanup must not be mixed with unrelated foundation rewrites in one commit.
